nurse.text: Shwmae, cariad! Croeso to Blaenavon Sanctuary. You've got the Blorenge in your hair. Come in and get warm.
What can we do for you?

then.text: There we are. Tea, a Welsh cake and a sit by the stove. A coal stove, naturally. It's Blaenavon.
All mended. Off you go. Hwyl fawr, and mind the sheep. They've got right of way and they know it.
The Ark's by the wall, love. It's quiet today. Not as quiet as down Big Pit, mind.
